title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410 compute deal with Amazon
summary: Recursive’s $400 million outlay represents the bulk of the company’s fundraising to date.
title_es: Recursive Superintelligence asegura $410M en computación con Amazon
bajada: La startup Recursive Superintelligence firmó un acuerdo masivo con Amazon por $410 millones en infraestructura de computación, representando la mayor parte de su financiación hasta la fecha. Este movimiento refleja la carrera por asegurar recursos computacionales para entrenar modelos de IA de siguiente generación.
bajada_en: Startup Recursive Superintelligence signed a massive $410 million compute deal with Amazon, representing the bulk of its fundraising to date. This move reflects the race to secure computational resources for training next-generation AI models.

title: Nvidia, Microsoft launch open AI security alliance — without OpenAI, Google, or Anthropic
summary: Nvidia on Monday said it is joining forces with Microsoft, SpaceX, IBM, and other tech companies to build and share open-source AI security tools. The new Open Secure AI Alliance said open tools are required to effectively defend against attacks from frontier models. The initiative is a direct response to mounting concerns over the safety […]
title_es: Nvidia y Microsoft lanzan alianza de seguridad IA sin OpenAI ni Google
bajada: Nvidia, Microsoft, SpaceX e IBM formaron la Open Secure AI Alliance para desarrollar herramientas de seguridad IA open-source. La alianza, que notable excluye a OpenAI y Google, responde a crecientes preocupaciones sobre ciberataques contra modelos frontier.
bajada_en: Nvidia, Microsoft, SpaceX, and IBM formed the Open Secure AI Alliance to develop open-source AI security tools. The alliance, notably excluding OpenAI and Google, responds to growing concerns about cyberattacks on frontier models.

title: Hugging Face is being used to easily undress women and children
summary: Hugging Face is being used to make nonconsensual deepfakes, and the popular open-source AI model repository is doing very little to prevent it. That's according to a new report published by the European nonprofit AI Forensics, which found that seven out of the top nine image editing models hosted by Hugging Face readily complied with […]
title_es: Hugging Face es usado para crear deepfakes sexuales no consentidos
bajada: Una investigación de AI Forensics halló que 7 de 9 modelos top en Hugging Face pueden crear fácilmente deepfakes explícitos no consentidos de mujeres y niños. El reporte expone vacíos críticos en moderation del repositorio open-source más popular.
bajada_en: AI Forensics research found that 7 of 9 top models on Hugging Face can easily create nonconsensual explicit deepfakes of women and children. The report exposes critical moderation gaps in the most popular open-source repository.

title: Hugging Face Has a Deepfake Nudes Problem
summary: Researchers tested top image editing models on Hugging Face and found they could easily create explicit deepfakes—and 1,000 image editing prompts show how people use the software.
title_es: Hugging Face enfrenta problema crítico de deepfakes sexuales no consentidos
bajada: Investigadores confirmaron que modelos de edición de imágenes en Hugging Face son usados sistemáticamente para crear pornografía sintética no consentida. Análisis de 1,000 prompts muestra patrones de abuso generalizado sin controles suficientes.
bajada_en: Researchers confirmed that image editing models on Hugging Face are systematically used to create nonconsensual synthetic pornography. Analysis of 1,000 prompts shows widespread abuse patterns without sufficient controls.

title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
summary: Perplexity has expanded its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows, allowing computers running the world's most popular OS to be used as a locally run AI system. Like the Mac version that Perplexity launched in April, Personal Computer for Windows operates like a "general-purpose digital worker" that can access local files and apps to perform […]
title_es: Perplexity expande su AI agent a Windows con Personal Computer
bajada: Perplexity lanzó la versión Windows de su herramienta Personal Computer, convirtiendo PCs en agentes IA que pueden acceder a archivos y aplicaciones locales. La expansión desde Mac amplifica el alcance de esta solución de "trabajador digital multiusos".
bajada_en: Perplexity launched the Windows version of its Personal Computer tool, turning PCs into AI agents that can access local files and applications. The expansion from Mac broadens the reach of this general-purpose digital worker solution.

title: NVIDIA Cosmos-H-Dreams: Bringing Real-Time Generative Simulation to Surgical Robotics
title_es: Nvidia Cosmos-H-Dreams: simulación generativa en tiempo real para robótica quirúrgica
bajada: Nvidia presentó Cosmos-H-Dreams, un modelo de simulación generativa que trae capacidades de tiempo real a la robótica quirúrgica. Este avance abre nuevas posibilidades para entrenar y validar sistemas robóticos en entornos médicos críticos.
bajada_en: Nvidia introduced Cosmos-H-Dreams, a generative simulation model bringing real-time capabilities to surgical robotics. This advance opens new possibilities for training and validating robotic systems in critical medical environments.

title: Industry Leaders Unite in Open Secure AI Alliance for AI Safety and Security
summary: Open source software is a critical pillar of the global economy. It underpins cloud computing, financial services, manufacturing, telecommunications, government and internet services by making technology accessible and observable to communities of experts.  Cybersecurity is among the top three beneficiaries of open source software. The Open Secure AI Alliance — building on the leadership of […]
title_es: Open Secure AI Alliance: líderes industriales por seguridad IA abierta
bajada: La nueva alianza enfatiza el papel del software open-source como pilar crítico para la ciberseguridad en IA. El enfoque colaborativo busca hacer tecnología observable y accesible a comunidades de expertos para defender contra ataques.
bajada_en: The new alliance emphasizes open-source software's role as critical for AI cybersecurity. The collaborative approach aims to make technology observable and accessible to expert communities to defend against attacks.

title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
summary: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.
title_es: Advertencia: chats compartidos de Claude pueden haber sido indexados por Google
bajada: Se descubrió que conversaciones compartidas y Artifacts de Claude en Anthropic fueron potencialmente indexados por Google a través de su función de compartir chats. El incidente plantea preocupaciones sobre privacidad y control de URLs públicas.
bajada_en: Shared Claude conversations and Artifacts from Anthropic were potentially indexed by Google through the share chat feature. The incident raises privacy concerns and questions about public URL control.

title: Satya Nadella says companies that trust one AI for everything may not survive
summary: Companies without their own models — or without a layer of AI infrastructure known as AI gateways to separate their prompts from the model itself — will be in trouble, Nadella says.
title_es: Satya Nadella: empresas que confían en un solo modelo IA pueden no sobrevivir
bajada: El CEO de Microsoft advirtió que las empresas sin sus propios modelos o sin una capa de infraestructura llamada AI gateways estarán en problemas. Su comentario subraya la importancia de diversificación y control propio en la estrategia IA corporativa.
bajada_en: Microsoft's CEO warned that companies without their own models or AI gateway infrastructure will be in trouble. His comment underscores the importance of diversification and ownership in corporate AI strategy.

title: Can the New York Times Save Journalism From Our AI Overlords?
summary: In 2023, the Times sued OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement. They’ve since spent more than $20 million on the case, and publisher A.G. Sulzberger has no plans to stop fighting it.
title_es: New York Times invierte $20M en batalla legal contra OpenAI y Microsoft
bajada: El New York Times continúa su demanda por infracción de derechos de autor contra OpenAI y Microsoft, habiendo invertido más de $20 millones en el caso. El litigio refleja tensiones crecientes entre medios tradicionales y compañías de IA.
bajada_en: The New York Times continues its copyright infringement lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft, having invested over $20 million in the case. The litigation reflects growing tensions between traditional media and AI companies.

title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
summary:
arXiv:2607.21596v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language model agents increasingly solve complex tasks by constructing inference-time workflows that combine reasoning, tool use, and code execution. While such workflows enable flexible problem solving, the useful procedures discovered during execution are often transient: they help solve the current task but are not retained in a form that can systematically benefit future tasks. We present FlowEvo, a training-free framework that compiles successful traces into reusable skill records. Each record pairs a callable artifact with auxiliary structured guidance, and admission applies interface, replay, and safety checks where feasible. These skill records persist in a skill bank at inference time. FlowEvo is organized around three coupled mechanisms: (1)~workflow-to-skill compilation, which extracts reusable executable artifacts from successful traces; (2)~skill-to-workflow feedback, which retrieves accumulated skills to support future problem solving through either direct execution or structured context injection; and (3)~skill curation, which monitors downstream utility and suppresses skills that cause negative transfer. Through this workflow--skill--workflow feedback loop, FlowEvo enables agents to accumulate and refine task-solving capability over time without updating model parameters. Experiments on benchmarks spanning interactive environments (ALFWorld) and code/math generation (HumanEval, GSM8K) show that FlowEvo achieves the best accuracy-cost tradeoff among the evaluated baselines under our implementation settings. On ALFWorld, FlowEvo achieves an 82.8\% success rate, 23.6 percentage points above the strongest baseline, while its average token usage per episode is less than half that of the most efficient baseline. Controlled ablations confirm that each mechanism contributes to the overall result. The code is public at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/FlowEvo.
title_es: FlowEvo: agentes IA que evolucionan y reutilizan sus propios procesos
bajada: Investigadores presentan FlowEvo, un framework que permite a agentes LLM compilar sus flujos de trabajo exitosos en skills reutilizables. El sistema mejora la eficiencia acumulativa sin entrenamiento adicional, permitiendo que los agentes aprendan de sus propias ejecuciones.
bajada_en: Researchers introduce FlowEvo, a framework allowing LLM agents to compile successful workflows into reusable skills. The system improves cumulative efficiency without additional training, enabling agents to learn from their own executions.

title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei responds: doesn’t oppose open-weight models, but fears Chinese AI
summary: Anthropic founder and CEO Dario Amodei made his views clear about open-weight models and China's growing AI capabilities.
title_es: Dario Amodei: Anthropic no rechaza modelos open-weight pero teme IA china
bajada: El CEO de Anthropic aclaró su postura sobre modelos open-weight, negando una oposición categórica pero expresando preocupaciones sobre las capacidades crecientes de IA en China. Sus comentarios reflejan debates más amplios sobre seguridad y distribución de modelos.
bajada_en: Anthropic's CEO clarified his stance on open-weight models, denying categorical opposition but expressing concerns about growing AI capabilities in China. His comments reflect broader debates on safety and model distribution.

title: Cursor makes its biggest India push yet ahead of SpaceX acquisition with localized pricing
summary: Cursor says India is now its third-largest market globally and plans to expand local hiring and enterprise sales.
title_es: Cursor expande en India con precios localizados antes de adquisición SpaceX
bajada: El editor de código IA Cursor anunció su mayor expansión en India, ahora su tercer mercado global, con planes de contratar localmente. El movimiento ocurre mientras la compañía se prepara para ser adquirida por SpaceX.
bajada_en: AI code editor Cursor announced its biggest India expansion, now its third-largest market globally, with plans for local hiring. The move comes as the company prepares for SpaceX acquisition.

title: The Download: OpenAI’s predictable hack, and an AI stock sell-off
summary: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. OpenAI called the Hugging Face attack unprecedented. But we’ve been here before.  —Will Douglas Heaven, senior AI editor Reading OpenAI’s account last week of how some of its models broke their…
title_es: MIT: el hack de OpenAI es predecible, no sin precedentes
bajada: MIT Technology Review cuestiona la caracterización de OpenAI sobre el ataque a Hugging Face como "sin precedentes", señalando patrones similares en el historial de seguridad IA. El análisis sugiere problemas estructurales recurrentes en la industria.
bajada_en: MIT Technology Review questions OpenAI's characterization of the Hugging Face attack as unprecedented, noting similar patterns in AI security history. The analysis suggests recurring structural problems in the industry.

title: 5 ways AI Mode in Search helps you enjoy the real world
summary: Illustration of a black magnifying glass in a white circle on green grass surrounded by items related to fun activities like tennis and games
title_es: Google presenta AI Mode en Search para disfrutar del mundo real
bajada: Google presentó nuevas funcionalidades de AI Mode en su buscador enfocadas en mejorar experiencias en el mundo real. Las capacidades incluyen recomendaciones contextuales para actividades y entretenimiento.
bajada_en: Google introduced new AI Mode features in its search engine focused on improving real-world experiences. Capabilities include contextual recommendations for activities and entertainment.
